payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the annotation scheme can be adapted to more domains due to the presence of generic intents and slots that overlap across different domains, promoting data reusability.

claims.text: The domain-specific nature of datasets limits data reusability across different domains, but there are generic intents that can be shared.
NLU++ includes both domain-specific and generic intent modules, facilitating cross-domain reusability of annotated data.
Experiments show potential for reusing annotated data across domains, indicating adaptability of the annotation scheme.
